reason: Make MLflow protection preflight fail without partial adoption state.
changes: Protection resolves and validates the candidate summary and optional superseded summary before any tag mutation.
A missing, ambiguous, or mismatched reference causes zero tag writes.
Successful mutation order is fail-safe: old supersession timestamp, new protected state, grace, then owner decision last.
